scientific_findings: Return edge not established: weekly primary12m mean residual +0.07pp vs50/50SPYBIL with descriptive interval spanning both signs; residual -1.96pp vs60/40SPYIEF and -3.00pp vs70/30SPYIEF
Weekly shallower MDD than full SPY does not prove downside-prediction information: mean MDD is deeper than fixed50/50SPYBIL and slightly deeper than60/40SPYIEF at primary costs
Direction TP/FP/TN/FN and WAIT overlay are separate counts; p=.5 remains ABSTAIN
WAIT outcome class is frozen-vol-band outcome proxy, not exante EV optimum or proof the missed winner was identifiable
Context-missing prevalence cannot explain error cause when the same fields are missing in correct cases
Calendar/year or old accessible policy observation does not by itself identify present macro regime; fundamentals/credit/expectations unavailable
limitations: Benchmarks use17 US annual start clusters, not102 independent scenarios; horizon labels share future prices,24m overlaps
Original trend outcomes already known before new comparator design, so exploratory residual research only
Fixed initial portfolio weights drift; simple period returns are not longitudinal CAGR or rebalanced allocation performance
USD SPY/IEF/BIL only; BIL proxy not guaranteed cash account yield; IEF 7–10Y duration risk
Economic exdate dividend reinvestment and current provider vintages, no witnessed original prices
OLS slope/intercept descriptive, no causal alpha or fitted decision weights
Missing financial variables do not justify declaring value/earnings/credit irrelevant
